addBaseWhitelist(address[]).details: Add buyers to the base whitelist.

params._buyersToWhitelist: Buyers to add to the whitelist.

addReinforcedWhitelist(address[]).details: Add buyers to the reinforced whitelist.

params._buyersToWhitelist: Buyers to add to the whitelist.

bonus().details: Return the current bonus. The bonus only changes in 1/BONUS_DIVISOR increments.
bonus().return: b The bonus expressed in 1/BONUS_DIVISOR. Will be normalized by BONUS_DIVISOR. For example for a 20% bonus, _maxBonus must be 0.2 * BONUS_DIVISOR.

finalize(uint256).details: Finalize by finding the cut-off bid. Since the amount of bids is not bounded, this function may have to be called multiple times. The function is O(min(n,_maxIt)) where n is the amount of bids. In total it will perform O(n) computations, possibly in multiple calls. Each call only has a O(1) storage write operations.

params._maxIt: The maximum amount of bids to go through. This value must be set in order to not exceed the gas limit.

redeem(uint256).details: Redeem a bid. If the bid is accepted, send the tokens, otherwise refund the ETH. Note that anyone can call this function, not only the party which made the bid.

params._bidID: ID of the bid to withdraw.

removeBaseWhitelist(address[]).details: Remove buyers from the base whitelist.

params._buyersToRemove: Buyers to remove from the whitelist.

removeReinforcedWhitelist(address[]).details: Remove buyers from the reinforced whitelist.

params._buyersToRemove: Buyers to remove from the whitelist.

search(uint256,uint256).details: Search for the correct insertion spot of a bid. This function is O(n), where n is the amount of bids between the initial search position and the insertion position.

params._maxValuation: The maximum valuation given by the contributor. Or INFINITY if no maximum valuation is given.
params._nextStart: The bidID of the next bid from the initial position to start the search from.

search(uint256,uint256).return: nextInsert The bidID of the next bid from the position the bid must be inserted at.

searchAndBid(uint256,uint256).details: Search for the correct insertion spot and submit a bid. This function is O(n), where n is the amount of bids between the initial search position and the insertion position. The UI must first call search to find the best point to start the search such that it consumes the least amount of gas possible. Using this function instead of calling submitBid directly prevents it from failing in the case where new bids are added before the transaction is executed.

params._maxValuation: The maximum valuation given by the contributor. If the amount raised is higher, the bid is cancelled and the contributor refunded because it prefers a refund instead of this level of dilution. To buy no matter what, use INFINITY.
params._next: The bidID of the next bid in the list.

setToken(address).details: Set the token. Must only be called after the IICO contract receives the tokens to be sold.

submitBid(uint256,uint256).details: Submit a bid. The caller must give the exact position the bid must be inserted into in the list. In practice, use searchAndBid to avoid the position being incorrect due to a new bid being inserted and changing the position the bid must be inserted at.

params._maxValuation: The maximum valuation given by the contributor. If the amount raised is higher, the bid is cancelled and the contributor refunded because it prefers a refund instead of this level of dilution. To buy no matter what, use INFINITY.
params._next: The bidID of the next bid in the list.

totalContrib(address).details: Get the total contribution of an address. This can be used for a KYC threshold. This function is O(n) where n is the amount of bids made by the contributor. This means that the contributor can make totalContrib(contributor) revert due to an out of gas error on purpose.

params._contributor: The contributor whose contribution will be returned.

totalContrib(address).return: contribution The total contribution of the contributor.

valuationAndCutOff().details: Get the current valuation and cut off bid's details. This function is O(n), where n is the amount of bids. This could exceed the gas limit, therefore this function should only be used for interface display and not by other contracts.
valuationAndCutOff().return: The current valuation and cut off bid's details.

withdraw(uint256).details: Withdraw a bid. Can only be called before the end of the withdrawal lock period. Withdrawing a bid reduces its bonus by 1/3. For retrieving ETH after an automatic withdrawal, use the redeem function.

params._bidID: The ID of the bid to withdraw.

devdoc.title: Level Whitelisted Interactive Coin Offering This contract implements an Interactive Coin Offering with two whitelists: - The base one, with limited contribution. - The reinforced one, with unlimited contribution.
